note: Rival step-ins: a battle is about to start and one of your rivals joins in. A = helps you, B = battles you first, C = throws a ball at a wild Pokémon before you. Odds are per eligible battle; each is seeded per stop so reloads agree. Dialogue tones: fierce (nemesis, contender, grudge), cocky (everyone else), warm (ally, kind). Tokens: {rival}, {mon} (the Pokémon involved), {ace} (the rival's own Pokémon).

fierce: {rival} crashes in beside you. "Don't think this means we're even. I just hate seeing a {mon} get away."
{rival} sends {ace} in at your side. "Take the shot, then I'm taking you down myself."
cocky: {rival} jumps in: "Need a hand? Kidding, you obviously do!" {ace} lines up beside you.
{rival} grins. "Let me show you how it's done!" {ace} joins the fight.
warm: {rival} waves and runs over. "There you are! Let's take this {mon} together!"
{rival} smiles. "I saw it from the hill. {ace} and I have your back!"

fierce: {rival} steps out of the shadows. "That trainer's mine to beat later. Today I'm fighting at your side."
{rival} glares at your opponent. "Nobody beats you but me. {ace}, go!"
cocky: {rival} cuts in with a smirk. "Two against one? Seems fair to me, or at least fun!"
{rival} struts over. "Don't worry, I'll make you look good out there."
warm: {rival} runs up, out of breath. "Sorry I'm late! Let's win this one together!"
{rival} bumps your shoulder. "We're a team today. Ready?"

fierce: {rival} turns away. "Next time we meet, there's no help. Remember that."
cocky: {rival} shrugs. "You're welcome. You owe me one, rival!"
warm: {rival} beams. "We make a great team! See you down the road!"

fierce: {rival} blocks your path. "You're not facing that until you get through me first!"
{rival} steps in front of you. "I want you worn down. Show me what you've got!"
cocky: {rival} slides in. "Hold on! Warm-up round first. Let's see if you're still any good!"
{rival} grins. "Whoa, that's mine to deal with... right after I beat you!"
warm: {rival} jogs up. "Before you go on, how about a quick friendly battle? Come on!"
{rival} laughs. "I can't let you pass without a battle! Ready?"

fierce: {rival} grits their teeth. "Fine. Take it. Go on, your team is patched up." Your Pokémon feel fully restored!
"Hmph. Don't get used to winning." {rival} tosses you a spray as a parting shot. Your team is healed!
cocky: {rival} laughs it off. "Okay, okay, you win! Here, patch your team up." Your Pokémon are fully healed!
"Not bad at all!" {rival} sprays your team with a Potion. Everyone is healed!
warm: {rival} hugs {ace}. "That was amazing! Let me heal your team, you'll need it." Your Pokémon are fully healed!
"Great battle!" {rival} tends to your team. Everyone feels refreshed!

fierce: {rival} smirks. "Too slow. That {mon} is mine now." A ball clicks shut: {mon} joins {rival}'s team for good!
"You lost, so I take the prize." {rival} catches the wild {mon} and keeps it!
cocky: {rival} twirls a Poké Ball. "Thanks for the warm-up! I'll take that {mon}." Click! {rival} catches it!
"Better luck next time!" {rival} throws a ball and the {mon} is caught for good!
warm: {rival} looks sorry. "I didn't want to win like this... but I'll take good care of this {mon}." It joins {rival}'s team.
"Sorry! I'll look after it, promise!" {rival} gently catches the {mon}.

fierce: {rival} walks up to your opponent. "You're finished. I'll finish this." They win in a few moves and leave you behind.
"Watch and learn." {rival} beats your opponent without effort. There's no prize for you here.
cocky: {rival} shrugs. "Guess I'll handle this one!" Moments later your opponent is beaten and the prize is gone.
"Don't sweat it, I got it!" {rival} wins the battle in your place and rides off.
warm: {rival} sighs. "Rest up, I'll take care of them." {rival} wins the battle for you, and your team is healed.
"You did your best. Let me do the rest!" {rival} beats your opponent. Your team is healed.

fierce: A ball flies over your shoulder! "Mine," says {rival}. The wild {mon} is caught and joins their team for good!
{rival} steps out. "Too slow again." The ball shakes... click! {mon} belongs to {rival} now!
cocky: Whoosh! A Poké Ball sails past your head and snaps the wild {mon} up. "Thanks for finding it!" calls {rival}.
"Finders keepers!" {rival} throws a ball first. Click! {mon} is caught and stays on {rival}'s team forever!
warm: A ball flies in from nowhere! {rival} peeks out. "Oops, I didn't see you there! It's okay, I'll take good care of it." {mon} joins {rival}'s team.
{rival} giggles. "Sorry, I was faster this time!" The wild {mon} is caught and becomes {rival}'s partner.

fierce: The air goes still. {rival} walks past you with a single ball in hand. "Legends don't wait for slow trainers." Click! The legendary {mon} is {rival}'s, and it will never leave their side.
"I've waited my whole life for this." {rival} captures the legendary {mon}. The sky itself seems to bow. This changes everything.
cocky: "Is that... a legend?!" {rival} doesn't hesitate and throws a ball. Click! The legendary {mon} is caught. "I'm unstoppable now!"
{rival} steals the spotlight: the legendary {mon} is caught! "Next time, bring a faster ball!"
warm: {rival} gasps and trembles. "It chose me... I'll protect it, I promise!" The legendary {mon} joins {rival} and will never be released.
"I can't believe it!" {rival} holds the ball tight. The legendary {mon} is theirs now. They look at you, almost apologetic.

fierce: A strange hush falls. {rival} raises a ball. "Mythical or not, it's mine." Click! The mythical {mon} vanishes into the ball. {rival} will never let it go.
"Nobody sees that Pokémon twice." {rival} catches the mythical {mon} before you can blink, and a chill runs down your spine.
cocky: "A mythical?! No way!" {rival} throws a ball, and the {mon} is caught. "Tell everyone: I caught a myth!"
{rival} winks and snaps the mythical {mon} into a ball. "Rare doesn't even cover it!"
warm: {rival} whispers, "Is this real?" A gentle click: the mythical {mon} is theirs, and it looks calm. "I'll treasure it."
"It wanted to come with me," says {rival}, glowing. The mythical {mon} joins their team for good.

fierce: {rival} stands taller. "Next time we battle, you'll face a legend. Train hard."
{rival} points at you. "Beat me if you can, and maybe I'll share the glory."
cocky: {rival} tosses you something. "Here, a little consolation prize. I'll be waiting for the rematch!"
"Don't look so sad!" {rival} says. "Here, take these. Come beat me for it!"
warm: {rival} pushes some candy into your hands. "Please take these. I know it hurts. Let's both become stronger!"
"I feel bad. Here's a gift," says {rival}. "We'll meet again, and I'll try to be worthy of it."
